release_rules.patch: Add case, event, evidence, counterexample or stricter detector without breaking schema
release_rules.minor: Change compatible validation rules or controlled data fields
release_rules.history: Existing case metadata and historical events immutable; append events, add cases, bump release_version
release_rules.closed_means: Regression detected and repair observed only; zero future recurrence NOT certified

cases.title_ko: 병합 성공 후 회계 정본 소유권 경로 잔존
cases.title_en: Stale canonical ledger owner after successful merge
cases.root_cause: A human-maintained ledger_ownership pointer was excluded from the original manifest's artifact-path SHA checks; CI success implied insufficient coverage.
cases.trigger: Rename of finance ledger without updating operations/PI_RISE_V0_2_0_VERSION_MANIFEST.json ledger_ownership field.
cases.observable: institutional_grants_and_contracts pointed to nonexistent funding/GRANTS_CONTRACTS_PUBLIC_LEDGER.md while artifact list already referenced _EN_KO.md.
cases.impact: Published release manifest contained a dead canonical ownership reference despite passing CI.
cases.counterfactual: A reviewer trusting only the green CI result would infer the canonical path was reliable.
cases.repair: Corrected ledger_ownership to _EN_KO.md, added fail-closed publication/path/hash guard and updated manifest tracked checksums.
limitations: Structural/sha checks do not prove the underlying financial claims.
Protection from bypass requires branch rule configuration.

events.note: Observed stale ledger ownership pointer and missing target on main.
Tracked artifacts were individually hashed but ledger_ownership was not cross-checked.
Added 13 mutation/unit checks and canonical pointer validation.
PR 275 synthetic-only integrity workflow succeeded; 75 unit tests, including 13 new tests.
PR 275 merged; main manifest 13/13 tracked hashes matched in subsequent readback.

cases.title_ko: 경로 필터로 인한 CI 게이트 사각지대
cases.title_en: Path-filtered workflow could miss invariant-breaking PRs
cases.root_cause: Original pi-rise-integrity workflow was path-filtered; edits outside selected paths were not assured to run its global integrity invariants.
cases.trigger: Repository-wide invariants were treated as if only a few paths could invalidate them.
cases.observable: Older .github/workflows/pi-rise-integrity.yml had pull_request.paths and push.paths conditions.
cases.impact: A structurally green or skipped CI state was not sufficient evidence that cross-references stayed valid.
cases.counterfactual: Cross-document or future changes outside the allowlist could evade the relevant gate.
cases.repair: PR 275 removed restrictive path filters for PI-RISE. PI-FLR itself adds an unfiltered PR/main workflow contract plus mutation check.
limitations: Unfiltered CI runs can still be bypassed by repository settings, branch rules, admin privilege or workflow edits.
No zero-future-incident guarantee; main branch required-check enforcement not verified.

events.note: Review of prior PI-RISE workflow identified selective trigger paths.
Required-check execution coverage and changed-file coverage were incorrectly coupled.
Expanded PI-RISE checks to each PR and main push.
PR-triggered CI succeeded after trigger policy change.
New CI trigger merged; branch protection is separate unresolved governance control.
Cannot claim enforced required status checks or permanent recurrence prevention without branch settings verification.

cases.title_ko: E010 실험번호 재사용으로 별개 연구의 증거·사전등록 상태 충돌
cases.title_en: E010 identifier collision across unrelated blocked and published experiments
cases.root_cause: Two independent studies shared experiment identifier E010 without globally enforced provenance and uniqueness boundaries: the blocked 2026-10-06 safety-inspection draft and the published 2026-10-12 exploratory one-shot synthetic experiment.
cases.trigger: The unmerged historic PR #20 and main's E010 used identical experiment label while representing distinct constructions, results and validation status.
cases.observable: GitHub PR #91 explicitly documents P0 E010 identity collision. Published experiments/e010/README_KO.md distinguishes legacy PR #20 from 108-case posthoc result; experiments/e010/RESULT.json declares a different model and synthetic status.
cases.impact: Risk of attributing a blocked dynamic-inspection preregistration, prior-art or negative outcome to unrelated published E010, thereby misleading researchers about evidence and novelty.
cases.counterfactual: If historical design and modern E010 were merged on identifier alone, a green CI could fail to distinguish an unexecuted preregistration from a self-run exploratory synthetic result.
cases.repair: PR #91 separated lineage in canonical README and bilingual evidence registers; added governance CI to reject benchmark import, study model replacement, false preregistration or scientific status promotion. PI-FLR-C04 now independently replays those invariants in all-PR CI.
limitations: The detector protects this known E010 collision, not global uniqueness of all past or future experiment identifiers.
A GitHub PR claim and status guard are not scientific reproduction or empirical validation.
No information obtained from Gmail; this case was independently verified from GitHub sources.

events.note: Pull request identifies a P0 collision: legacy blocked safety-inspection E010 vs independently published exploratory E010.
Archived October 6 safety-inspection draft never produced a scientific E010 result; canonical E010 is a different model.
Bilingual source registry and E010 result identity protections introduced without combining experiment histories.
Original E010 analytic falsification/recorded-result workflow passed for PR #91 head.
PR #91 correction merged; blocked PR #20 remained separate and unmerged.
A corrected known identity collision alone does not establish repository-wide uniqueness or reliability of future identifiers.

cases.title_ko: 변경된 README 해시가 정본에 갱신되지 않아 연쇄 시험 실패
cases.title_en: Stale funding index blob hash masks unrelated mutation-test diagnostics
cases.root_cause: A finance README content change and manifest-tracked Git blob SHA drifted; the verifier fails on SHA before later negative mutation expectations, creating cascaded diagnostic failures.
cases.trigger: Changes on PI-RISE dual-clock branches were tested before refreshing the shared manifest SHA.
cases.observable: GitHub Actions #39480338397: STALE_GIT_BLOB_SHA:funding/README.md; 2 assertion failures and one test error in the same run.
cases.impact: PI-RISE integrity check blocked, and tests for duplicate/missing records failed prematurely on unrelated SHA drift.
cases.counterfactual: A mutation test that validates the injected failure before external artifact consistency would attribute all 3 faults correctly instead of masking two with an earlier stale hash.
cases.repair: Known cause isolated. Updated primary manifest SHA on main observed, but no dedicated mutation-ordering remediation independently established.
limitations: This case documents historical branch failures, not a currently confirmed failing main.
Failing tests may reflect branch drift rather than a permanent global implementation defect.
Gmail alert is discovery evidence; GitHub log is technical root-cause evidence.

events.note: Gmail GitHub Actions failure alert cross-checked with original job output: hash mismatch in funding/README.md.
Second failed run reproduces stale hash mismatch and mutation-test error masking.
Main baseline may differ; do not claim that every historical failure is unresolved or automatically fixed.

Same stale Git blob SHA mechanism recurred on a different tracked README.md path while English-first public README was changed; root README actual hash diverged from frozen manifest, not an assertion about the prior funding README.
A later PR modifying only the README order workflow still failed PI-RISE on stale tracked README blob SHA; workflow success in another job did not certify overall release.
The recurring root README manifest mismatch has not been verified repaired in this incident intake. A new documentation/test ledger alone does not resolve it.

cases.title_ko: 신규 PI-RISE 문서의 언어판 등록 누락
cases.title_en: New PI-RISE dual-clock edition omitted from language catalog
cases.root_cause: The added bilingual PI-RISE DC document had not yet been included in the language-edition register during the candidate branch workflow.
cases.trigger: New operations/PI_RISE_DC_V0_1_0_EN_KO.md in the dual-clock branch.
cases.impact: Bilingual entry audit failed, blocking candidate release until registry and new documents agree.
cases.counterfactual: An atomic new-document plus language-register update, validated before PR creation, would avoid the repeated failed checks.
cases.repair: The specific premerge failure is identified; later merged repository inventory must be consulted to assert final remediation.
limitations: The mail proves a failed workflow, not that the present main remains broken.
Naming alone is not independently certified translation quality.

events.note: GitHub failure email cross-validated against language edition audit job.
Job explicitly reported NEW_MARKDOWN_NOT_REGISTERED for PI_RISE_DC_V0_1_0_EN_KO.md.
Candidate branch register omission is historical; current merged register status must not be inferred from the old email.

cases.title_ko: PI-CORE RG-0 후보 영문 2개 문서의 미존재 C10 대상 링크
cases.title_en: Two RG-0 draft EN documents linked to a crosswalk missing in the failing commit
cases.root_cause: At GitHub Actions run 39479053663, two RG-0 v0.7 English candidate Markdown files linked to research/PI_CORE_01_RG0_C10_CROSSWALK_V0_7_EN.md which was absent in that checkout.
cases.trigger: PR #250 candidate modifications to RG-0 specification and six test cases before publication reference completeness.
cases.observable: check_public_navigation.py --strict-all reported unresolved local links: 2: research/PI_CORE_01_RG0_SIX_CASES_V0_7_EN.md:6 and research/PI_CORE_01_RG0_SPEC_V0_7_EN.md:6, both to the same missing C10 crosswalk.
cases.impact: Candidate's public governance workflow failed; branch document bundle was not link-complete at that commit. This is not a currently published main broken link.
cases.counterfactual: Resolving every newly introduced local link against the candidate's complete head before opening PR detects both missing targets and rejects partial bundles.
cases.repair: At the later inspected PR #250 head the crosswalk target exists and both references resolve; this is a candidate-state observation only, not evidence of merge or successful current PR CI. Add a dedicated negative mutation and an all-PR navigation gate.
limitations: PR #250 is open and unmerged; main has none of these RG-0 v0.7 English files.
An old failed run does not prove present candidate still fails.
No independent semantic or scientific verification.

events.note: Exact job log reported two unresolved RG-0 v0.7 links to the missing C10 English crosswalk at lines 6.
Source is open RG-0 v0.7 PR #250; GitHub candidate head now contains both source files and C10 crosswalk, while main lacks the draft.
Current draft link target presence does not imply a merged result or independence of scientific claims.

cases.title_en: English-first README change broke language locality and legacy top-level entry contracts
cases.title_ko: 영어 우선 README 전환 과정에서 영문 순도·기존 L0 진입 규칙 위반
cases.root_cause: The language-order requirement was implemented as a content reordering without jointly migrating pre-existing L0-first Korean checks and English-only prose boundaries. Root cause within the exact prose token is not independently isolated from the job summary.
cases.trigger: Pull request #341 added English first 15-second/1-minute/5-minute content while preserving earlier founding statements and leaving cross-document release contracts unchanged.
cases.observable: GitHub Actions run 39658035497 failed README_ENGLISH_SECTION_CONTAINS_KOREAN_PROSE; run 39658035704 failed L0_NOT_FIRST and first-view/staging checks; run 39658035525 failed NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE_HIDDEN.
cases.impact: The PR merged although language, README-purpose and navigation checks failed, creating a misleadingly completed bilingual public-entry change.
cases.counterfactual: A pre-merge cross-workflow matrix plus mutation of English prose leakage and L0-first policy would have surfaced the incompatible edit and prevented a global success description.
cases.repair: Add recurring failure case and an English-only mutation test using the real publication detector. Complete bilingual README/guard migration and all relevant workflow passes have not been established.
limitations: No claim that all broken language and navigation workflows are repaired.
The exact invalid token's causal role remains a log-derived hypothesis; inspect raw changed prose and compare against checker.
Required GitHub status checks enforcement not independently verified.

events.note: Public English/Korean language separation failed for PR #341 head; job log reported README_ENGLISH_SECTION_CONTAINS_KOREAN_PROSE.
README purpose guard expected legacy Korean topmost view and failed after explicit English-first reordering; incompatible entry contract was not migrated.
Separate PI-ACCESS navigation check also failed NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE_HIDDEN; issue remains open until check outputs and public reading route are consistent.

cases.title_en: Partial-green README checks and successful merge misrepresented wider release readiness
cases.title_ko: 일부 녹색 검사·병합 성공을 전체 릴리스 해결로 확대
cases.root_cause: Release reporting did not use a complete declared-workflow denominator; the repository allowed a PR merge with other CI failures, and a later narrow English-order success was reported without the still-failing PI-RISE job. Ruleset/blocking mechanics remain unverified.
cases.trigger: PR #341 merged with four failed CI workflows; PR #343 English-order validation passed but PI-RISE synthetic-only integrity still failed.
cases.observable: Observed PR #341 head workflows include four failures (language, purpose, navigation and PI-RISE) among 10 results; PR #343 had a successful English-first check and a failed PI-RISE check.
cases.impact: An apparently resolved main README or successful language-order automation could mask unresolved failures and impose further verification work on the researcher.
cases.counterfactual: A full-scope status matrix must block global completed assertions on failed, skipped, pending or unobserved required checks, even if a PR was merged.
cases.repair: Add evidence-graded conversation failure ledger, a scoped workflow matrix function and negative mutation tests. The function protects reporting logic only; repository required-check enforcement is separately unresolved.
limitations: A passing synthetic matrix test is not a live GitHub merge gate.
Not all failing CI jobs are proven to have the same root cause.
No external branch-ruleset or admin-bypass audit has yet been performed.

events.note: README PR was merged despite failing multiple other checks; success of merge alone was not full system repair.
PR #343's separate README-order check passed but PI-RISE synthetic-only integrity failed; no evidence of completed global release gate.
Formal regression and conversation evidence storage do not establish required-check branch protection or repair the manifest SHA mismatch.
During PR #348, C11 forced-failure regression unexpectedly returned SCOPED_REPLAY_PASS: mock compared basename with full argv path; CI failed and provided independent detection.
Mock predicates used 'pi_rise_manifest_guard.py' in command-list and 'check_readme_l0.py' in command-list, but argv contained tools/ prefixes; the injected error never fired.
Replaced basename membership predicates with exact allowlisted tools/... argv path membership in both existing and new mutation regressions.
Subsequent PR head passed PI-FLR registry and replay mutation tests; actual subprocess receipts reported FLR_META and FLR_MUTANTS pass. This is scoped code evidence.
PR #348 squash merged after all four observed workflows were green; v0.5.0 C11 on main read back.
This fixes an observed unit-test fixture defect, not independent long-term recurrence control or autonomous model learning. Earlier negative mock detection failure remains preserved.

cases.title_en: Material changed files went unassigned to historical tests while replay reported scoped success
cases.title_ko: 주요 변경 파일이 회귀검사 매핑에서 누락돼도 부분 성공으로 보고
cases.root_cause: The C11 test selector reports unmatched changed paths but does not classify potentially material paths as release blocking; git diff also excludes deletions with --diff-filter=ACMR, so removed files do not enter its denominator. Missing test-selection coverage could be mistaken for safety.
cases.trigger: PR #348 executed C11 replay after adding multiple PI-FLR source, JSON and tests; coverage counter reported 8 changed paths but only 3 matched, and the exit status still indicated SCOPED_REPLAY_PASS.
cases.observable: GitHub PI-FLR run 39666295003 recorded changed_paths=8, matched_paths=3, unmatched_path_count=5 and status=SCOPED_REPLAY_PASS; the published code used --diff-filter=ACMR.
cases.impact: Potential failure of new or deleted high-impact files could escape incident-specific replays, while a green scoped receipt appeared to establish completion.
cases.counterfactual: A conservative selected-test gate would list every material change, inspect both sides of renames/deletions, and block release if a material path cannot be linked to at least one suitable regression.
cases.repair: Introduce coverage-closed changed-path selection, explicit matching for PI-FLR registry and test files, safe reject for unmapped code/config/data, and negative tests for deletes/renames and incomplete mapping; deployed effectiveness unobserved.
limitations: A matched path only proves a bounded local test was selected, not comprehensive semantic impact testing.
No independently observed real-world bug prevented; the CI log demonstrates selection omission, not a consequential production incident.
Full scientific effectiveness and branch required-check enforcement are not verified.

events.note: Replayed check receipt gave a green SCOPED_REPLAY_PASS while 5/8 changed files had no known-risk mapping.
Selector's unmatched counter did not gate status; --diff-filter=ACMR excluded deleted file entries, creating an additional denominator blind spot.
Observable static coverage gap recorded; remedy not called merged, field-verified or universally sound before new CI receipts.

improvement_protocol.invariant: No event removed and no root-cause or attribution silently rewritten; changed interpretations via appended notes and new version.
improvement_protocol.anti_proxy: CI pass is a limited code assertion, not proof of real-world truth, financial receipt, semantic parity, universal safety, or zero future incidents.
improvement_protocol.next_expansion: Prior-art replay selects tests with coverage-closed material changed-file inventory; changed and deleted/renamed high-impact files without suitable mapping block release. Scope-only pass never proves all semantic effects, and source/provenance receipts cannot claim SLSA attestation or field recurrence reduction.
improvement_protocol.governance_gap: Branch protection/required checks and administrative bypass settings are not verified in this registry.
